# Copilot Instructions

Users describe the outcome; do not require them to name a workflow or role. Delegate repository mutation, formal review, and testing requests to `snapshot-workflow`, which owns classification and execution. Answer ordinary non-mutating questions, explanations, status checks, read-only exploration, and documentation lookups directly.

Always preserve the project constraints in `AGENTS.md`, never expose secrets, and do not claim routing is a deterministic VS Code hook.
